title: Regis Decision Ledger Entry v1
description: Append-only ledger entry. The Regis graph is a materialized view rebuildable by replaying these entries in order. Merge and unmerge are first-class entries; nothing mutates canonical state except through the ledger.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence within the ledger lane.

before_refs.description: Entity/record ids whose state this entry supersedes (enables deterministic unmerge/replay).

reverses_entry_ref.description: When op is unmerge/unlink, the prior entry being reversed.

prev_entry_ref.description: Hash-chained predecessor; null for the genesis entry.

entry_hash.description: Hash over (prev_entry_hash, op, decision_ref, targets, payload) for tamper-evident replay.
